account: It is day 0, just after 09:00. I came from home to the office and took the appointment book from its chest to read today's schedule. The secretary has noticed the empty chest and asked whether I have the book and which engagements to arrange. That is explained by my taking it, not evidence of anything suspicious. Today's schedule is office correspondence, a 10:00 plaza market walk, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I have asked about correspondence, urgent business, and which cottage hosts tea, but have not yet received answers. Several townsfolk have passed within sight near the hall; I do not know their business. So far I have seen or heard nothing unusual in town beyond the secretary's understandable uncertainty about the missing book.
